description: A hard polished stone or steel tool drawn across a gilded edge to compress and brighten the gold to a mirror finish. The working face is ground smooth and free of sharp corners so it cannot scratch the leaf; agate or bloodstone are common heads.
name: burnisher

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1902), Chapter VI, p.97. Internet Archive.
